title: Design: two customers ticked look as in the design picture
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices on today's date; customer {Customer-B} has nothing open.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-74 10 Trucking and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST D-74 4 Star Truck Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • The design picture "Two customers ticked" (ar-ap-p7-two-customers-ticked.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Customer chip.
  2. Tick {Customer-A} and {Customer-B}.
  3. Close the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: both are ticked. As in the picture: both names show as blue tags, each with an "×", inside the search box, and a circled "×" sits at the box's top right; "All customers" is unticked with "2 selected" at its right; the helper line is gone; the ticked customers keep their place in the A to Z list; the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers" in a blue pill.
  • Step 3: the menu closes. As in the picture: one row, {Customer-A} ({Customer-B} has nothing open, so it is not listed); the Totals row equals {Customer-A}'s row, an empty bucket reading $0.00 in the Totals row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • S1-E1: “A customer with no open documents on the as-of date does not appear, as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-two-customers-ticked.png: figure "Two customers ticked" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"

The design's own words:

  • "Customer menu with 10 Trucking and 4 Star Truck Repair ticked ("2 selected", shown as tags in the search box): the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers", and rows and Totals narrow to them (4 Star Truck Repair has nothing open). S5-R13, S5-R14, S5-R19." (caption of "Two customers ticked")

Design note (DR-04): the design shows the Customer menu with two ticked shows the ticked names as tags in the search box, a clear "×", and "2 selected" on the "All customers" row. Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R13 "Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter"; the PRD lists the menu's main rows, the design shows the native extras. The design case checks them.
